research_notes: Seek public professional CV or employer records for Prestige Events, Yarra Valley Snack Foods, Mars and Ritual, and Paterson-office tenure; confirm individual hours, leave, transitions and potential overlaps.

2026-09-29 checked frozen APH occupations, member first speech/about page, Liberal biography, IPAC profile, September 2026 interview publisher and contemporaneous 2021 local reporting. Targeted Mars/Ritual/Paterson searches located contact-aggregator dates but these were not accepted as employment evidence. LinkedIn URL linked by interview publisher returned 999; no access restriction bypassed.

Frozen occupation labels retained here for future reconciliation: Head of Partnerships; Senior Manager; Regional Partnerships Manager; Field Sales Head; Field Sales Manager; National Sales Manager. They cannot yet be individually dated or conclusively mapped to each employer, so employer-level spells avoid inventing six additive tenures.

The fifteen-year commercial-career narrative cannot establish fifteen substantive full-time years, particularly with an undated political-staff spell. Approximate seven-year snack-food duration is preserved only in evidence prose. No duration arithmetic or double counting applied.

Member's current about page mentions local business work, community volunteering and sporting committees but does not add an employment chronology. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; unresolved cases remain blocked, not complete.

2026-10-02 follow-up: publicly indexed professional profile supplies month boundaries for Paterson political staffing and Ritual, plus Mars Wrigley interval. No direct LinkedIn retry or gated access. Snack-food profile snippet describes eight years one month versus biography seven-year narrative; exact original entry boundaries need verification before changing2007 start. Aggregator suggests earlier Wrigley and several snack-food positions, but these remain leads, not adopted dates. Next: original dated employer records and hours,Prestige catering dates,snack-food start conflict and2022 Ritual/election overlap. Do not sum promotions or assume stock options mean full-time. Remains unresolved.

2026-10-03 follow-up materially enriches the earliest paid job: in parliamentary debate Violi says he began paid Prestige Events work at15, continued during high school and university, and worked marquee weddings and winery partnerships for owners Michael and Gayle Thwaites. The broad study-period description is not treated as uninterrupted tenure or full-time status. Contemporary July2022 reporting says he left Ritual's APAC partnerships-head role to run for parliament, but supplies no day and conflicts with the public profile's June2022 endpoint after the21May election; retain the overlap and do not invent campaign leave. Searches did not resolve Prestige dates/hours, the snack-food seven/eight-year conflict, pre-December2017 Mars service or employer-confirmed Ritual boundaries. No duration calculated.
